 """Evaluation of small arithmetic formulas."""
 
+import re
 from collections.abc import Mapping
+
+_TOKEN_RE = re.compile(r"""
+    (?P<NUMBER>\d+(?:\.\d+)?)
+    | (?P<NAME>[a-zA-Z_]\w*)
+    | (?P<OP>[+\-*/%^(),])
+    | (?P<SKIP>\s+)
+    | (?P<MISC>.)
+""", re.VERBOSE)
 
 
 class EvalError(ValueError):
     """The formula is malformed or cannot be evaluated."""
 
 
+def _tokenize(formula: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
+    tokens = []
+    for m in _TOKEN_RE.finditer(formula):
+        kind = m.lastgroup
+        if kind == "SKIP":
+            continue
+        if kind == "MISC":
+            raise EvalError(f"unexpected character {m.group()!r}")
+        tokens.append((kind, m.group()))
+    if not tokens:
+        raise EvalError("empty formula")
+    tokens.append(("EOF", ""))
+    return tokens
+
+
+class _Parser:
+    def __init__(self, tokens: list[tuple[str, str]], variables: Mapping[str, int | float]):
+        self.tokens = tokens
+        self.variables = variables
+        self.pos = 0
+
+    def peek(self) -> tuple[str, str]:
+        return self.tokens[self.pos]
+
+    def advance(self) -> tuple[str, str]:
+        tok = self.tokens[self.pos]
+        self.pos += 1
+        return tok
+
+    def expect(self, kind: str, value: str | None = None) -> tuple[str, str]:
+        tok = self.peek()
+        if tok[0] != kind or (value is not None and tok[1] != value):
+            raise Eval
